bioconda.name: assaycode
bioconda.summary: Compatibility metapackage for the assaycode command included with DotMatch.
bioconda.description:
This metapackage installs the matching DotMatch release, which provides the
assaycode compatibility command for compiling and inspecting assay
specifications alongside the main dotmatch command.

commands: python -c "import assaycode, dotmatch; assert assaycode.engine is dotmatch"
